finding.claim: Any logged-in session can modify or start any other player's advertisement (lobby) by ID, because Update and UpdateState never check that the caller is the host.
finding.source: sessionID-authenticated request with client-chosen advertisement id (update.go q.Id; updateState.go q.AdvertisementId)
finding.sink: adv.UnsafeUpdate(&q) (models/advertisement.go:356-379) and adv.UnsafeUpdateState(q.State) (models/advertisement.go:419), which sends MatchStartMessage to all peers

trace.note: UnsafeUpdate overwrites password, visibility, joinable, state

finding.guards_checked: Session presence (SessionMiddleware) and per-ID write lock only. No host-ownership check. Sibling handlers do check: updateTags.go:62, party/peerAdd.go:29, party/peerUpdate.go:30 compare UnsafeGetHostId() to the session user.

finding.claim: Game login accepts any platformUserID with no proof of ownership under the default Authentication='disabled', and a login kicks the victim's existing session (account takeover). Flagged per org policy: weakens authentication.
finding.sink: sessions.GetByUserId + sessions.Delete, then sessions.Create for the victim user (platformlogin.go:34-39)

trace.note: auth middleware only wired when Authentication != 'disabled'

finding.guards_checked: required/cached modes do verify upstream (authMiddleware.go:46-236) but are not the default; cmd/root.go:100-101 only logs a warning. Platform IDs are exposed to other players (see F7).

finding.claim: PlayFab LoginWithSteam never verifies the Steam ticket signature, and LoginWithCustomID accepts any int32 user ID, so any client can mint a session for any known account (authentication bypass). Flagged per org policy: weakens authentication.
finding.source: SteamTicket hex (LoginWithSteam) or CustomId (LoginWithCustomID) in request body
finding.sink: sessions.CreateWithSteamUserId / CreateWithUserId (models/playfab/session.go:54-68) returning bearer token used by playfabapiMiddleware

trace.note: SteamID read from fixed offset, no signature check
session created for any known SteamID
CustomId parsed as int32, no ownership check

finding.guards_checked: Length bounds in ParseSteamIDHex and user existence check only. No cryptographic ticket verification. Unknown users receive an empty token with HTTP 200 (session.go:55-57, :63-65).

finding.claim: Session IDs, PlayFab tokens and cloud-download signatures are drawn from a math/rand PCG seeded with time.Now().UnixNano() (or a fixed seed if Deterministic), so they are predictable given the server start time and a few observed values.
finding.source: Attacker knows approximate server start time and observes own issued tokens
finding.sink: Game sessionID (models/session.go:22-30), PlayFab token (models/playfab/session.go:82-88), cloud sig (models/credentials.go:13-22)

trace.note: 30-char session IDs drawn from shared PRNG
cloud sig = SHA-256 of predictable PRNG bytes

finding.guards_checked: Sessions expire (5 min game, 24 h PlayFab). SHA-256 wrap adds no entropy. Feasibility of seed recovery NOT verified by running the PRNG.

finding.claim: Gauntlet mission rewards can be farmed indefinitely: the client asserts Won=true, StartGauntletMission accepts any MissionId, and there is no attempt limit or outcome verification.
finding.source: MissionId and Won in CloudScript ExecuteFunction parameters (any logged-in AoM player)

trace.note: only check is exact match to in-progress ID

finding.guards_checked: Exact-match check on in-progress mission. No validation of mission ID, no attempt limit, no server-side result. elements[1] at line 37 panics on IDs without '_' (recovered by net/http; low impact).

finding.claim: Access log writes the full RequestURI, so session IDs sent in GET query strings and cloud sig values are written to stdout and to the file logger. Violates org policy: never log tokens.
finding.source: sessionID query parameter on GET game routes; sig on /cloudfiles/ downloads
finding.sink: writer.Write in logFormatter, to stdout (cmd/root.go:212-214) or file logger (cmd/root.go:215-216)

trace.note: FormValue accepts sessionID from query string

finding.guards_checked: POST bodies are not logged, so only GET routes leak. Log retention not verified.
